title: A covenant on every run of years
heading: A Cap on Carry-Over and a Cap on a Window Are More Rows on the Same Expressions
cases: a plan whose every run of k years fits the cap is allowed, and one that breaks the first run is refused
the runs overlap: each year starts one, not every k-th year
the last run of k years ends in the plan's last year
each run holds k years, so a plan can fit every shorter run and still break one
